$comment: Round 33 lane I1 ledger fragment (instrument measurement, not a sweep). Merge into liber-primus/LEDGER.json.

entries.hypothesis: Replacing the English-quadgram search score of the driftbeam with a register-aware score (design 1: max over the nine I2 register trigram LMs) lifts planted EN_NOVOWEL recovery to >= 0.90 at L=120 without costing any register > 0.05.
entries.verdict: INSTRUMENT-REPAIRED (design 1, panel_max); kill rule did not fire; null/bars need a v3-specific refit before sweep use
entries.coverage: 9 registers x 3 matched relations (keyskip1/1, skip_by_two/2, free_q05/free) x L{120,400} x 20 plants for driftbeam and v3 panel_max; shuffle null n=100 per decoder x relation x L; Q5 checkpoint 80 decodes; tuning seeds 500-509; designs 2 and 3 only at L=120 on EN_NOVOWEL + EN_MODERN x 3 relations x 20 plants; speed on 4 decodes per cell. Correct key + offset handed to decoder.
not_covered: cross-relation (mismatched decoder) cells for all nine registers
L=6000, sign +1, plants with wrong key/offset, supp != 0.83, non-SHA-256-CTR keystreams
transition model: resets, advance >= 3, interrupters, rewrite/keyside/plainside constructions, > 2 unexplained advances per rune
adjudicator registers outside the nine-register trigram panel (Greek, Hebrew, Norse, mixed/unknown)
null on the real shuffled LP2 stream (R32 I1's planted-shuffle null was reused)
Gumbel refit of v3 wrong-key pmax at large N (hitfn20 panelmax bars were fitted on driftbeam and do not apply to v3)
designs 2 and 3 on the full grid; design 3 fails V2 on EN_MODERN free (0.896 vs 0.979)
plants are clean corpus windows; real LP2 text not tested
entries.threshold: VALID iff EN_NOVOWEL median recovery >= 0.90 at L=120 skip_by_two/advance 2 AND no register x matched relation x L cell falls > 0.05 below same-plant driftbeam (or R32 I1 published median); fixed in PREREG.md before any output.

result.bars: threshold_for(N, segment_len=L) = -5.5 (floor) at N=100 and 1e6, both L; en bar blind to NOVOWEL (planted en about -7.9). hitfn20 panelmax bars (N=1e6: 7.63/7.38/13.84) were fitted on driftbeam; v3 own shuffle-null max pmax binds.

entries.overlap: transition relations are round19/I1 driftbeam (unchanged); envelope grid follows round32/I1 with the nine-register I2 panel and I2 testhalves plants (driftbeam re-run on identical plants as baseline).
entries.reopens_if: any of: the transition model is extended (resets, advance >= 3) and the envelope re-run; a register outside the nine-register panel is hypothesised; a v3 wrong-key Gumbel refit shows plants no longer clear the sweep-scale bar; wrong-key / non-planted real-LP2 text shows the search score hallucinating a register.
